_about: Neon Harbour as a plan (Claude I, lane I), v2: Claude F's schema (#174). The ria, the sea, the islets, the Heights and the Glint from the block-out (docs/vision/research/blockout/blockout-v52.json (#187, claude-a/blockout-data)); lane G's grid routes (lib/world-routes.ts on claude-g/blockout (#189) 395bf4d) and their tiers (local 0 = world 1, the strand); outlines in the grid shape on 16 px cells (Matt 11:44). The block-out's tiers run higher than G's city level; G's numbering is kept and the block-out's shapes give the order (the Heights 7 to 9 become world 4 to 6). The market is at the old bridges' west foot (G's stop; the roads and the canal arrive from the west). Things moved to fit keep moved_from.
